business_summary: China Testing & Certification International Group Co.,Ltd. provides inspection, testing, and certification services in the fields of building materials and construction engineering in China. The company offers engineering testing, material testing, environmental testing, food, and agricultural product testing services; product certification, including safety glass, ceramic tiles, and automotive brake pads; voluntary product certification; management system certification, and service certification services; and scientific research and technical services. It also engages in the research, development, and sale of testing instruments; provision of intelligent manufacturing services; and instrument metrology and verification services for industries, such as machinery, electronics, textiles, pharmaceuticals, building materials, chemicals, testing institutions, and research institutes. The company was formerly known as China Building Material Test & Certification Group Co., Ltd. China Testing & Certification International Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
